# STD-TEC-NXT-006: Next.js Testing Standards

**Standards Metadata**

```yaml
standard_id: 'STD-TEC-NXT-006'
standard_name: 'Next.js Testing Standards'
standard_type: 'technology'
category: 'technology'
version: '1.0.0'
status: 'active'
compliance_level: 'mandatory'
tags: ['technology', 'nextjs', 'testing', 'jest', 'playwright', 'mandatory']
```

---

> This document defines the testing standards for Next.js development within enterprise environments. These standards ensure comprehensive test coverage, consistent testing practices, and reliable quality assurance processes for React applications with unit testing, integration testing, and end-to-end testing strategies.

[standards/technology/nextjs/STD-TEC-NXT-006-testing.md#10-overview]

## 1.0 Overview

This document defines testing standards for Next.js applications within enterprise environments. These standards ensure consistent, maintainable, and effective testing practices across all frontend applications.
page_texts.10:
[standards/technology/nextjs/STD-TEC-NXT-006-testing.md#31-directory-structure]

### 3.1 Directory Structure

Tests should mirror the source code structure:

```
src/
  components/
    UserProfile/
      UserProfile.tsx
      UserProfile.module.css
      __tests__/
        UserProfile.test.tsx
  app/
    dashboard/
      page.tsx
      __tests__/
        page.test.tsx
  lib/
    utils/
      formatDate.ts
      __tests__/
        formatDate.test.ts
```
page_texts.11:
[standards/technology/nextjs/STD-TEC-NXT-006-testing.md#32-file-naming]

### 3.2 File Naming

- Use `.test.ts(x)` or `.spec.ts(x)` suffix for test files
- For component tests, match the component filename
- Group related tests in a `__tests__` directory
page_texts.31:
[standards/technology/nextjs/STD-TEC-NXT-006-testing.md#81-test-isolation]

### 8.1 Test Isolation

- Each test should be independent
- Clean up after each test
- Avoid shared state between tests
- Use appropriate setup and teardown hooks
page_texts.32:
[standards/technology/nextjs/STD-TEC-NXT-006-testing.md#82-testing-performance]

### 8.2 Testing Performance

- Mock external services appropriately
- Use snapshot testing judiciously
- Implement proper test timeouts
- Monitor test execution time
page_texts.33:
[standards/technology/nextjs/STD-TEC-NXT-006-testing.md#83-coverage-requirements]

### 8.3 Coverage Requirements

- Minimum 80% code coverage for new code
- 100% coverage for critical paths
- Coverage requirements by component type:
    - UI Components: 90%
    - Utilities: 100%
    - API Routes: 90%
    - Data Layer: 95%
